formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : ℕ) (x2 : SimpleGraph (Fin x1)) (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∃ (x4 : Fin x1) (x5 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x4 x5) → (∀ (x5 x6 x7 x8 : Fin x1), x5 ≠ x6 → x5 ≠ x7 → x5 ≠ x8 → x6 ≠ x7 → x6 ≠ x8 → x7 ≠ x8 → x2.Adj x5 x6 → x2.Adj x6 x7 → x2.Adj x7 x8 → ¬x2.Adj x8 x5) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x3 → (∀ (x7 : Fin x1 → Bool), x3.eval (List.ofFn x7) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x8 : Fin x1) (x9 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x8 x9 ∧ x7 x8 = Bool.true ∧ x7 x9 = Bool.true) → PEqualNP.BicliqueBlockCost.HasBlockCost x2 x3.size
plain_statement: A graph with an edge and no 4-cycle; C a circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, for its edge function. Then some family of blocks (pairs of disjoint nonempty vertex sets, completely joined) covering every edge costs at most the size of C, a block (A, B) costing |A| + |B| - 1 and the family its blocks' costs plus the number of blocks minus one.
title: A step toward: Graphs without a 4-cycle: every circuit of AND and OR gates for the edge function has at least |E| + tau - 1 gates
